name: img-val
description: TypeScript CLI for LLM-based image valuation

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @llm-image/shared build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');for(const d of ['standards/builtin','storage/migrations']){const src=path.join('src',d),dst=path.join('dist',d);fs.rmSync(dst,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync(src,dst,{recursive:true});}"
